title: Kin Score output block
description: The score:, regulatory:, provenance:, and agent_readiness: blocks written to a provider record by the Kin Score scorer. schema_version 0.6.

authorship.description: Who published the artifact. first-party = the provider wrote and serves it (credit 1.00). conformance = the provider serves it, a standards body wrote it (0.75). derived = API Evangelist authored it on the provider's behalf (0.25). mixed = a part-derived contract corpus, credit interpolated on the derived share. unknown = no marker either way, credited in full.
authorship.$comment: unknown is credited in full deliberately: only artifacts the enrichment pipeline authored carry a marker, so absence of one is not evidence of derivation.

dimension.description: A dimension is false, true, or a GRADE STRING. Graded-on-evidence dimensions return verified/partial/documented; provenance-graded dimensions return their authorship state; agent_card returns its A2A conformance grade. A grade string is never merely truthy - 'derived' is a different fact from 'the provider runs one'.

score.description: The composite Kin Score and its facet breakdown.

composite.description: 0-100 weighted composite. For regulated providers = 0.85*base + 0.15*regulatory; otherwise = base.

band.description: Cut points re-derived in 0.6: exemplar 66+, strong 56, developing 42, thin 28, emerging 13, minimal 0.

facets.description: The six base facets, each 0-100. Weights (fixed in the rubric): contract_quality 0.25, developer_ergonomics 0.20, commercial_clarity 0.20, operational_transparency 0.13, governance 0.12, discoverability 0.10.

regulatory.description: Present ONLY for providers in a regulated industry (matched by tags via industry_regulatory). The conditional 7th facet.

regime.description: Human label of the matched regime family, e.g. 'Banking & Open Finance'.

regime_id.description: Extensible; telecommunications and energy_utilities were added in 0.6.

matched_via.description: 0.6+. 'tags' means a strong tag matched. 'weak_tags' means the regime matched only on an ambiguous tag (broker, brokerage, exchange, trading) because nothing else matched anywhere - a weaker claim, and the mechanism that stopped insurance brokers being scored against MiFID II.

provenance.description: 0.6+. WHO PUBLISHED the artifacts being scored. Read this before quoting the composite: a strong contract_quality built on specs API Evangelist modeled is a different fact from one built on specs the provider serves.

marker_coverage.description: Percentage of this provider's specs carrying ANY provenance marker. Catalog-wide this is 2.4%, so contract provenance is a floor rather than a census - an unmarked spec is credited in full.

callable.description: Percentage whose servers[].url resolves to a registrable host, as opposed to a placeholder domain (example.com) or a bare template variable ({apiRoot}).

agent_readiness.description: The standalone Agent Readiness score. Never merged into the composite.

band.description: Cut points re-derived in 0.6: agent-native 46+, agent-ready 34, agent-aware 6, human-only 0. A BAND GATE applies: no provider is agent-native without both idempotency and error_semantics, however high it scores.

dimensions.description: Fourteen dimensions as of 0.6 (twelve at 0.4, plus agent_card in 0.5.1 and dry_run_mode in 0.6). Most are booleans; seven can carry a grade string - see $defs/dimension.

spec_presence.description: 0.6: satisfied by an OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL or FHIR CapabilityStatement.
